name: Proof / Engineering Dossier
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: ONE original, exceptional PROFESSIONAL PERSONAL PORTFOLIO desktop webpage design screenshot, 1536x1152 landscape, actual flat page edge-to-edge, no laptop/browser/phone/presentation frame. Show a richly composed landing page with a hero and meaningful selected-work evidence directly beneath.
Input image: Identity reference ONLY, the actual engineer's source photo. Integrate this EXACT recognizable man in a deliberate editorial crop: swept black hair, moustache and light beard, black suit, white shirt, dark tie, NO GLASSES. Preserve face, age, proportions and expression faithfully. No different man, no AI glamour face, no cartoon avatar. Image may be cropped or treated in monochrome as specified, but preserve identity and natural skin detail.
Core identity, clear at first glance: 'Zohaib Haider' and 'Full-stack AI Engineer'. Supporting title 'Software engineering · AI systems · Product delivery'. User says approximately two years of work; a precise small label '2+ years of hands-on engineering' is permitted. A small '4 selected projects' label is permitted. DO NOT invent revenue, users, awards, big clients, performance metrics, employment seniority, or claim all projects were solo.
Mandatory truthful project evidence: show ALL FOUR exact names and their purpose with readable text and useful visual specifics:
1. 'OpsPilot' — 'AI incident investigation' — 'RAG · LangGraph · QLoRA · Voice'. Visual workflow must communicate retrieval/citations, agent reasoning, and human approval before sensitive execution. A small accurate sample path is 'Retrieve → Investigate → Approve → Execute'.
2. 'HR Intelligence' — 'Intercom AI support assistant' — 'Gemini · Intercom · Box sync'. It is an AI support assistant embedded in Intercom, NOT a hiring/recruitment/candidate scoring platform.
3. 'DSP' — 'Driving school marketplace' — 'GraphQL · Stripe Connect · Socket.IO'. Show bookings + payments, not hotels/real estate/travel.
4. 'RTA Marketing' — 'Automotive CRM + vehicle intelligence' — 'Puppeteer · SQS → Lambda · Redis'. Show vehicle-data pipeline, not generic fintech, not an AI model.
The owner has experience with agentic AI/RAG, fine-tuning/voice, full-stack APIs, payments and cloud data pipelines. Use clear capability group labels 'Agentic AI + RAG', 'Fine-tuning + Voice', 'Payments + APIs', 'Cloud + Data pipelines'. Highlight a small curated stack: Python / TypeScript, React / Next.js, FastAPI / Node.js, PostgreSQL / Qdrant, AWS. DO NOT cram the user's 100+ dependency list into the hero. These capabilities should be visible as meaningful evidence tied to projects.
Navigation must be easy: Work / Capabilities / Experience / Contact. A clear 'Explore case studies ↗' action. Small experience line 'Jidat IT / Full-stack development'. Do not add unrelated project names.
High aesthetic standard: exceptional contemporary sans-serif typography, mature palette, precise grid, beautiful meaningful dimensional visuals, personal presence, nuanced hierarchy, calm reading areas. Essential text must remain readable. Static frame of PROPOSED sophisticated 3D animation, with clear interaction cues; do not imply an actual running video.
Critical: each design is a different composition and niche. NO ordinary headline-left/photo-right split hero, NO giant serif/italic luxury slogans, NO chrome ribbons, NO glowing brain/orb, NO sci-fi dashboard wallpaper, NO cloned SaaS template, NO glass plinths holding four fake dashboards, NO generic catchphrase replacing clear role/evidence, NO wall of skill badges, no watermark. It must immediately read as the portfolio of this particular capable AI/software engineer with actual project work.
COMPOSITION AND ART DIRECTION: PROOF, a luminous editorial ENGINEERING DOSSIER. Warm offwhite #F3F2EC, charcoal #1C2421, muted moss #9CAE91, vivid but sparse orange-red #E86A45. Refined humanist sans-serif, nuanced regular/medium weights; exact type hierarchy, no shouty ultra-bold slogans. Modern professional and distinctly personal.
A. Top 8% clean navigation and small name mark.
B. Next 20% FULL-WIDTH IDENTITY HEADER, not split columns. Across the width, a tight precise 'Zohaib Haider' name in 64px, then 'Full-stack AI Engineer' in 46px. At the far upper-left a small 145px square crop of the exact source portrait, naturally integrated into the type grid like a publication byline. On right a compact TWO-LINE proof ledger '2+ years of hands-on engineering' / '4 selected projects', no fake counters. Under the role a crisp sentence 'I build AI workflows, production APIs, payment systems, and the data pipelines behind them.'
C. Main middle 36% ONE beautiful full-width layered ENGINEERING MAP like a contemporary architectural exhibition model, matte ivory and dark green low extruded planes with miniature flat process diagrams, precise orthogonal routing and small orange moving-signal marks. Four elegantly connected capability regions, labeled clearly: 'Agentic AI + RAG' near a little retrieve→reason→approval flow, 'Fine-tuning + Voice' near a precise waveform and stacked model layers, 'Payments + APIs' near booking→Stripe Connect→webhook path, 'Cloud + Data pipelines' near Puppeteer→SQS→Lambda path. It is a clear capability system, not a random sculpture or an infinite node editor. Crisp flat UI labels over the perspective drawing, tiny 'EXPLORE A CAPABILITY' hint, careful whitespace. One small central annotation 'From interface to intelligence to infrastructure.' Contemporary technical art direction, elegantly dimensional with soft daylight shadows, no shiny materials.
D. Lower 28% FOUR gorgeous wide editorial project previews laid side-by-side, each has a refined colored top rule, project name, exact purpose and 3 or 4 actual stack terms. Miniature diagrams tailored to each project rather than generic dashboard placeholders: OpsPilot investigation flow, HR Intelligence conversation/sidebar, DSP booking+Stripe Connect, RTA vehicle pipeline. Titles large/readable, role caption clear. Every project arrow opens a case study.
E. Bottom8% thin experience rail 'Jidat IT / Full-stack development', essential stack in one restrained line, dark 'Explore case studies ↗' button.
The hero is an evidence-led personal introduction and a visually impressive 3D capability map, integrated over full width. Looks like an ambitious design engineer's real portfolio with substance.
